title: Robotic plate queue
tables: A 24-48 plate carousel or magazine, barcode reader, guarded transfer axis and recoverable nests.
Schedules incubation and imaging, preserves chain of custody and reduces manual handling.
The flagship must demonstrate multi-sample operation and overnight autonomy.
A constrained custom mechanism is cheaper and easier to validate than a general robot arm; capacity is a design target, not a confirmed specification.
